subject: gray wolf
title: Wolves Wiped Out Every Deer on Their Island, Then Hunted Sea Otters

scenes.text: These wolves ate all their island's deer. They didn't starve.
Wolves reached Pleasant Island, Alaska, around twenty thirteen. Soon the deer had crashed.
Scientists expected the pack to starve. Instead, it grew from three to thirteen wolves.
Their poop revealed why. By twenty seventeen, sea otters were over half their diet.
The wolves patrol the shore at low tide, killing otters resting on rocks or in shallow water.
Deer fell from three quarters of their diet to seven percent. The wolves went to sea.

description:
After wolves colonized Pleasant Island in Alaska around 2013, the deer population collapsed. Scientists expected the pack to starve. It grew instead.
Scat showed sea otters went from 25% of the diet in 2015 to 57% in 2017, while deer fell from 75% to 7%. GPS collars show wolves kill otters at low tide.
Did you know wolves could hunt sea otters?
first_comment: Researchers found 28 sea otters killed by wolves in just three month-long field seasons. Which would you bet on in a fight, a wolf or an otter?
